On the pinned payloads that unbounded adversarial term drives decoder2 to diverge (median one-step reconstruction error grows from 0.16 to 2.5e8 within two epochs), so the shipped run disables the negative sign and is reported as an ablated, non-adversarial two-decoder ensemble; the divergence itself is kept as a recorded negative result.
